units: Car GLB native units (KFB_CVP1_cabrio.glb, scale 1). Character values in KayKit rig units. World metres = rig units x 0.616 (scale A).

driverSeat.note: FB sits 0.10 rig units further forward than the seat centre + 0.12*carScale so its arms reach the wheel

hands.ik: 2-bone IK on upperarm/lowerarm, target = grip point on the rim, pole outward-down

feet.pedals: not reached: right toe is 0.26 rig units short of the gas pedal; legs hang (look decision open)

ears.cabrioOpen: free; FB-EARS-FLOPPY-01 'B Floppy' with wind = -vehicle velocity (m/s)

hop.path: quadratic Bezier hips path, control point 0.15 behind the midpoint, apex so the lowest FB vertex clears the door top
hop.yaw: +90 -> 180 deg during flight (turn to face forward), ease in/out
hop.poses: stand -> crouch (45% towards seated) -> seated pose held in flight (tuck) -> land with 0.07 dip; IK influence 0 in flight, eases to 1 over the landing
hop.exit: mirror: dip in seat, fly out to the left, land facing away (-X), rise to stand

drive.lean: spine+chest roll 0.5*lean, head counter-roll 0.3*lean, lean = clamp(-0.02*lateralAccel, +-0.35 rad)
drive.bounce: hips offset from a spring on vertical acceleration (k 60, c 7)

testTrack.shape: ellipse a 24, b 16 rig units, hump 0.9

measuredFindings: Mixamo entering/exiting clips do not fit FB in the cabrio at x1.8: door sill is about 2x FB's hip height; after 2 repair passes FB still passed through side wall, door and seat -> replaced by the hop (Georg 30.09).
Side windows reach 2.53 (scaled) and block the hop; roll them down (hide) in the cabrio.
Interior mirror sits in front of FB's mouth.
